# Tower 28 Beauty

> Clean, vegan makeup & skincare made with non-irritating ingredients for sensitive skin. Shop derm-tested staples that won't sting with Tower 28.

Canonical storefront: https://www.tower28beauty.com

## Catalog
- [All products](https://www.tower28beauty.com/products.json): public JSON catalog with price, availability, variants, and images.
- [Sitemap](https://www.tower28beauty.com/sitemap.xml): every indexable URL, including product pages.

## Policies
- [Shipping](https://www.tower28beauty.com/policies/shipping-policy): dispatch windows, regions, and rates.
- [Returns](https://www.tower28beauty.com/policies/refund-policy): return window, condition, and refund timing.
- [Privacy](https://www.tower28beauty.com/policies/privacy-policy): data collected and how it is used.

## Contact
- [Support](https://www.tower28beauty.com/pages/contact): human contact channel and response target.

## Machine notes
- Product pages carry schema.org Product JSON-LD with offers, price, currency, and availability.
- Autonomous shopping agents may read this site's public catalog and policy pages.
- Product identifiers include SKU so agents can match listings across merchants.
